```{r}
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
results_dir <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/2_main/panel3/intermediates/")
```

#p3 complete
```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.2}

p3_complete
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/p3_split.pdf", plot=p3_complete,width = 7.5, height = 4.2)
```
